record.title: position vector
record.name: PositionVector
record.content:
In the space $\mathbb{R}^3$, the vector $$\vec{r} \;:=\; (x,\,y,\,z) \;=\; x\vec{i}+y\vec{j}+z\vec{k}$$ directed from the origin to a point \,$(x,\,y,\,z)$\, is the {\em position vector} of this point.\, When the point is \PMlinkescapetext{variable}, $\vec{r}$ \PMlinkescapetext{represents} a vector field and its \PMlinkescapetext{length} $$r \;:=\; \sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}$$ a scalar \PMlinkescapetext{field}.
The \PMlinkescapetext{simple formulae}  egin{itemize} \item $
abla\!\cdot\vec{r} = 3$ \item $
abla\!	imes\!\vec{r} = \vec{0}$ \item $\displaystyle
abla r =  rac{\vec{r}}{r} = \vec{r}^0$ \item $\displaystyle
abla rac{1}{r} = - rac{\vec{r}}{r^3} = - rac{\vec{r}^0}{r^2}$ \item $\displaystyle
abla^2 rac{1}{r} = 0$ \end{itemize} are valid, where $\vec{r}^0$ is the unit vector having the direction of $\vec{r}$.
If\, $\vec{c}$\, is a \PMlinkescapetext{constant} vector,\, $\vec{U}\!\!:\mathbb{R}^3	o\mathbb{R}^3$\, a vector function and\, $f\!\!:\mathbb{R}	o\mathbb{R}$\, is a twice differentiable function, then the formulae  egin{itemize} \item $
abla(\vec{c}\cdot\!\vec{r}) = \vec{c}$ \item $
abla\cdot(\vec{c}	imes\vec{r}) = 0$ \item $(\vec{U}\!\cdot\!
abla)\vec{r} = \vec{U}$ \item $(\vec{U}\!	imes\!
abla)\!\cdot\!\vec{r} = 0$ \item $(\vec{U}\!	imes\!
abla)\!	imes\!\vec{r} = -2\vec{U}$ \item $
abla f(r) = f'(r)\,\vec{r}^0$ \item $\displaystyle
abla^2f(r) = f''(r)\!+ rac{2}{r}f'(r)$ \end{itemize} hold.
